purpose: Bind already-prepared prospective race sets to the exact v54 B1a_MKT50_v1 model, selector and validation rules before future racecards/results become available.

prospective_capture_protocol.membership: Use only the race/event membership fixed by the source future manifests; when exact Day1 racecards become available, freeze exact race IDs before any result join.
prospective_capture_protocol.pre_inputs: Capture only contemporaneous pre-result race/rider inputs and genuine pre-close odds needed by the frozen model/selector.
prospective_capture_protocol.prediction: Compute B1a_RECONSTITUTED_v1 winner layer unchanged, then B1a_MKT50_v1 exact-order ticket probabilities, then v54 selector output.
freeze_before_outcome: odds artifact hash and capture timestamp/provenance
prospective_capture_protocol.missed_pre_rule: If required PRE or genuine pre-close odds are missing at cutoff, the race/ticket is a closed miss for evidence collection and must never be reconstructed after results.
prospective_capture_protocol.outcome_join: Forbidden before the race/cutoff and requires a later explicit scoring authority if governance still requires it at that time.
